tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i nor lha yak+ṣa dzam+bha la chen po'i srog dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rin chen chu 'dzin ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru yak+ṣa dzam+bhā lā
༄༅/ /rdo rje'i nor lha yak+ṣa dzam+bha la chen po'i srog dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rin chen chu 'dzin ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru yak+ṣa dzam+bhā lā

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i nor lha yak+ṣa dzam+bha la chen po'i srog dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rin chen chu 'dzin ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru yak+ṣa dzam+bhā lā ya/ mi bskyod rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gnod sbyin gyi/ /sde dpon tshul 'dzin rdo rje khro bo ches/ /byin gyis rlobs mdzod zab mo srog gi dbang*/ /skal bzang don gnyis sgrub pa'i dpal du sbyin/ /yak+ṣa kā la'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi snod du rung zhing nus pa thob par byed pa zab mo srog gi dbang bskur ba la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po gshom bkod ni/ stegs bu'i steng ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yod na bkram/ med na 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu lha grangs bkod pa'i dbus su thod pa sku rten srog 'khor rnams bkod/ de steng 'phrul stegs la lha bum nyer lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings sngon po kha rgyan can bsham/ g.yas su rten gtor/ rgyab tu mda' dar/ g.yon du g.yang rdzas/ mdun tu tshe 'brang tshe ril tshe chang dang bcas pa/ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rnams kyi tsakli/ phyi mchod/ gtor 'bul/ tshogs chas sogs phrin las kyi gsham bkod du gsal ba ltar tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ thog mar sgrub mchod ni/ las byang ltar brgyud 'debs nas brtsam/ sngon 'gro rnams btang*/ dngos gzhi bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas grub pa dang*/ bum sgrub ni/ bum pa rang byung pho brang dbus: pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng : sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ ye shes me phung klong du 'gying : dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i: sogs nas/ byin rlabs nus stobs bsdus te thim: sku las rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur: ces dmigs pa bsnyen sngags ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ lha 'od du zhu ste bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces mos/ de nas mdun bskyed btang*/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa ci 'grub mthar mchod bstod 'bul/ thun mtshams bya ba gsum ka ma lcogs na gtor 'bul dang tshogs mchod gang rung gis 'thus/ thugs dam bskul/

las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed bzlas bya/ slob ma gzhug pa'i gnang ba nod do/ /de nas dbang dngos la phyi rol du slob ma khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs gtor btang la bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad/ gral la 'khod cing me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad khyad par/ de'ang sems can gang zhig sngon bsags bsod nams kyi stobs dman pas zas gos nor gyi 'byor pas phongs shing dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams kyi don du rigs lnga'i rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs las sar gnas sems dpa' gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po'i tshul du sprul pa mgon po dzam+bha la'i mtshan dang snying po thos shing bzung ba tsam yang skye ba kun tu dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las grol zhing longs spyod mi zad pa'i gter dang 'phrad nas spyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par 'gyur ba sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas legs par gsungs pa 'di la rigs dang mtshan gyi bye brag mang du mchis pa rnams kyi nang nas/ mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo chen po yak+ṣa dzam bha la nag po'i gdams skor rnams 'phags pa'i yul du tshong dpon gyi bu+u dha na saṃ bho la bka' babs/ de nas rim par brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gsar ma'i phyogs su kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i zhal snga nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa byung ba dang*/ rnying ma'i phyogs su sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+mā ka ras dha na saṃ bho'i gdams pa rnams rgyal po gu ru de ba las gsan pa'i tshul mdzad cing*/ yak+ṣa rtsa ba'i tan+t+ra dang*/ rat+na rtsal chen 'dus pa'i rgyud le'u sum brgya bdun cu rtsa bdun pa'i zab gsang snying po'i yang bcud dum bur phyung ba dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rin chen gter spungs zhes bya ba lag len dmar khrid kyi tshul du bsdebs nas/ bod yul gyi mnga' bdag rje blon rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su gdams/

snyigs dus tha ma'i gdul bya rnams kyi don tu ye shes dhā ki mtsho rgyal gyis dpe rgyud 'dra min gsum du bkod nas gter gnas so sor rgyas btab pa/ mon chu mo phug gi gter kha mchog dbyangs rnam 'phrul dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis bton/ lha ri brag gi gter kha lha sras mu tig dang dam 'dzin zung du 'jug pa'i rnam rol gu ru jo bo tshe dbang dar pos drangs/ dus skabs so sor 'gro don ci rigs pa mdzad/ sngags 'chang rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa bal po a hūm̐ 'bar gyis spa gro cal gyi brag dmar po'i nub phyogs me lce 'khyil ba 'dra ba nas me pho 'brug lo ston zla ra ba'i nya la spyan drangs nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ bar skabs su dar rgyas che ba byung na'ang phyis brgyud pa'i nges tig med pa dang gter chos kyang nub pa ltar gyur pa'i skabs/ rab tshes lcags 'brug lo'i cho 'phrul zla bar gter 'byin rgya mtsho'i mkhor los sgyur ba pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la chos bdag mkha' 'gros srog 'khor man ngag dang bcas pa'i dpe rnying dngos su phul cing sgrub thabs kyi skor rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul du stsal ba la brten nas gtan la phab pa'i skabs su mnal lam dam pa'i snang bar/ yul ljongs shin tu nyams dga' ba zhig gi kha stod ri bo glang chen 'gying ba lta bu'i gdong pa'i thad tsam du rje nyid phebs pas rgyang ring po nas 'od kyi gong bu ljang gu shin tu bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa la je nyer sleb pa'i tshe rdo shel ljang nag dwangs pa la nyi zer phog pa'i rkyen gyis 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs su 'phro ba/ dbyibs nor bu mig gcig lta bu che zhing dwangs pa zhig gi drung du slebs pa na ngo mtshar gyi snang ba bcas nang du zhugs pas rin po che'i khri bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du dzam bha la nag po ljang 'od 'tsher ba/

zhal phyag sogs mngon rtogs dang mtshungs pa shin tu gsal ba la 'khor rnams kyang yod dgongs pa byung*/ de nyid skad cig gis o rgyan snang srid zil gnon gyi skur gnas gyur nas 'di'i smin grol gyi gdams pa chig rdzogs su stsal/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi skor rnams sngar bal po a hūm̐ 'bar dang gu ru jo tshe'i gter dpe gnyis po gcig lta bu yod pas brgyud pa gnyis 'dres su 'gyur ro gsungs pa'i gnang ba dang bcas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes/ nor lha rnams kyi nang nas kyang 'di sgrub pa la rgab 'dre'i bar chad med cing bcas pas chog pa'i 'khor lo sogs zab gnad ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba dang ldan pa'i gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po'i srog dbang zab mo bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la/ rin po che sogs gces pa'i nor rdzas kyi maṇ+ḍal phul du gzhug /bla ma dang gsang ba'i bdag po dbyer med pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos thal sbyar dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma gsang bdag dpa' bo che: bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas: gnod sbyin sde dpon dzam+bha la'i: dngos grub dbang bskur stsal du gsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la gsang ba'i dam tshig bsgrag cing gnang ba sbyin pa yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal: 'di ni yak+ṣa kā la che: bka' gnyan byin rlabs nus stobs bdag: dam tshig srog bzhin bsrung nus na: dbang bskur sbyin gyi gzhan du min: ces bsgo zhing dam chu bdud rtsi sbyin/ ji ltar bsgos pa'i dam las nam yang mi 'da' bar khas len cing tha tshig gi bro bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje'i dam las 'da' mi bya: sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma gsang ba'i bdag po dang mdun bskyed gnod gnas dbang po'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtshos sprin gtibs pa ltar bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams dang lhan cig pas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos/

na mo: bdag dang khams gsum 'gro ba kun: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: rtsa ba gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum ngang du gnas gyur cig: lan gsum/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kun: sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i phyir: gnod sbyin dbang po'i bskyed bzlas dang : mchod bstod sgrub la brtson par bgyi: lan gsum/ rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa'i ting nge 'dzin tshig don re re bzhin gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la/ /dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ lan gsum/ de nas dbang gis gzhi dgod pa ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun la dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /las bum chu dang*/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ chos thams cad dmigs su med pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang po dang gnod sbyin pho mo zung gi khri'i steng du/ rang sems hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'od 'bar ba las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi dpal 'byor dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te thim pa las 'od zer mthing nag gi gong bur gyur/

de las skad cig gis khyed rang bcom ldan 'das mgon po dzam+bha la sku mdog gnag la snum pa'i mdangs 'od 'tsher ba/ mi'u thung gtum zhing khros pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig spyan gsum khro gnyer bsdus shing mche ba bzhi btsigs pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos rdo rje'i tho ba gsor cing g.yon dang pos nor bu'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba/ g.yas 'og mas rin po ches bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa g.yon 'og mas gter gyi ne'u le bzung ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rat+na'i rtse bran dang ldan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs 'phyangs shing sprul rigs lnga dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rtags kyi mtshan ma gyen du sgrengs zhing zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang pa'i 'dor thabs kyis ye shes me 'od 'bar ba'i klong du 'gying ba/ nor rgyun lha mo ljang gu lcags kyu dang gter bum bsnams pas g.yon phyogs nas 'khyud pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer nam mkha' gang ba 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang lcang lo can nas sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa char chen babs pa lta bur spyan drangs nas sgo gsum la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig byas la sbyar ba'i spos bsreg /rol mo bsgrag /oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā: badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes drag tu brjod la dbab/ rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ de nas dbang bskur dngos la/ gnyen po'i lha dbang*/ gnod sbyin dbang po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dbang*/ mtha' rten tshe'i dbang rnams rim par spyin pa'i thog mar bum pa'i dbang la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bum pa'i bdud rtsis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas dregs can mtha' dag zil gyis gnon pa'i gnyen po stobs kyi dbang chen rdzogs par mos shig

/rnam bum spyi bor bzhag /bum chu mthor 'thung byas la/ oṃḥ bkra shis bum pa'i pho brang na: gsang bdag 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i chus: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gnyen po stobs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: ka la sha a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus kyi nang gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pas rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod rdo rjes dbur brgyan par gyur/ sgrub pa'i sku rten 'di nyid gnod sbyin dzam bha la nag po dngos su gsal ba khyed rang gi dpral bar thim pas bskyed rim sgom pa'i snod rung du gyur/ ye shes sku'i gzi byin 'bar bar mos shig /sku rten dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ: yak+ṣa kā la dzam bha la'i: rdo rje'i sku yi dbang bskur bas: lha tshogs bsgom pa'i snod du gyur: ye shes gzi byin 'bar bar shog: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas pa'i lung blang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi steng rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mthar 'khod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros/ mdun bskyed khyed rang rnams dang bcas pa'i thugs srog sngags phreng la phog pas/ nus pa'i stobs bskyed/ gzi byin lhag par 'bar/ thugs dam gnyan po'i rgyud bskul bas sngags phreng las 'od zer gyi sprin nam mkha' khyab par 'khrigs pa las 'dod rgu'i dngos grub kyi char chen po babs par mos la bsnyen sngags kyi rjes zlos/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā: zhes lan gsum bzlar gzhug

/slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis gnod sbyin dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul bas sku'i gzi brjid bskyed/ gsung gis sngags sgra bsgrag /thugs las ye shes kyi 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yos/ 'khor 'das kun gyi bcud dang dpal 'byor/ lha klu mi'i longs spyod ma lus pa 'ub kyis bsdus nas rang gi yul phyogs bang mdzod gnas khang thams cad khengs/ dwangs ma rang rang gi sgo gsum la thim 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas chen por gyur par mos la sgrub sngags kyi rjes zlos/ oṃ yak+ṣa kā la dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya ba su dha rī sarba tsit+ta rat+na sid+dhi hrīng hrīng dzaḥswā hā: zhes lan gsum/ srog 'khor glegs bam gnod sbyin dbang po'i gsung gi ngo bo mgrin par bzhag pa la/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod kyi snod rung du gyur/ rig sngags kyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i nus rtsal rdzogs par mos shig

/srog 'khor dang*/ rgyas pa med na 'khor lo'i bri yig bcas mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥ yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i nor bu sngags: rdo rje'i gsung gi dbang bskur bas: bzlas shing grub pa'i snod du gyur: dngos grub nus rtsal rdzogs par shog: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ āḥ mtshan ldan ban+dha rdzas bcud kyis bltams pa mgon po dzam+bha la'i thugs 'od gsal ye shes chen po'i rten snying gar bzhag pas/ rnam thar gsum ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i snod rung du gyur/ lhar snang dang chos nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs par mos shig /ban+dha snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐: rang byung 'od gsal kā pā la: rdo rje'i thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i snod du gyur: lha dang chos nyid dbyer med shog: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: g.yang gtor rin chen 'bar ba dpal ldan yak+ṣa kā la chen po'i yon tan yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i ngo bos dbang bskur bas/ phywa g.yang dpal 'byor sgrub pa'i snod rung du gyur/ yid la 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pa la dbang brnyes par mos shig /gtor ma lte bar bzhag la/ swā: gtor ma 'dod 'byung nam mkha'i mdzod: yon tan rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas: dpal 'byor bsgrub pa'i snod du gyur: 'dod rgu'i char chen 'bebs par shog: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ye swā hā: gu na a bhi ṣiñtsa swā: phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba'i thog mar thugs dam bskul zhing phywa g.yang gi bcud bsdu ba yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod cig /bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: mdun bskyed 'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskul: gtum zhing sgeg pa'i gzi byin bskyed: rdo rje'i sngags kyi sgra chen bsgrags: ye shes 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros: stong gsum 'jig rten khams kun g.yos: 'khor 'das kun gyi bcud dang dpal:

lha klu mi yi longs spyod tshogs: rang dbang med par 'ubs kyis bsdus: bdag gi bang mdzod gnas khang dang : yul phyogs thams cad phyur bur khengs: dwangs ma rten rdzas rnams la thim: yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i dpal du gyur: hūm̐: bkra shis yid 'ong grub pa'i zhing : longs spyod gter gyi pho brang nas: rigs kyi khyab bdag dzaṃ bha la: btsun mo dpal ldan nor gyi rgyun: nor lha rab 'byams tshogs dang bcas: rtse gcig gus pas bsgrub lags na: byams pa'i zhal bzang dus 'dir ston: dgyes pa chen po'i gzi byin bskyed: dngos bshams yid las byung ba yi: nyer spyod 'dod yon sprin ltar gtibs: snod bcud ri gling 'byor pa'i tshogs: bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyal srid bdun: bum bzang 'dod 'jo dpag bsam shing : gtor ma skyems phud ro bcud ldan: zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyis: g.yar dam bskang zhing nyams chags bshags: mos shing gdung bas rgyud bskul na: thugs rje thugs dam dbyings nas dgongs: stong gsum 'khor 'das rab 'byams kyi: snod kyi 'byung ba'i phywa g.yang khug: bcud kyi 'byor pa'i phywa g.yang khug: mdzes sdug gzugs kyi phywa= snyan brjid sgra yi= bsung zhim dri yi phywa= bcud ldan ro yi= 'jam 'khril reg bya'i= yid mthun chos kyi= lha yi bdud rtsi'i= klu yi nor bu'i= gnod sbyin gter gyi= gling bzhi mi yi= pho brang mkhar gyi phywa= rigs brgyud sras kyi= mnga' ris bde skyid phywa= dpa' rtsal stobs kyi= sra brtan go cha'i= rkang bzhi phyugs kyi= lo tog 'bru bcud phywa= bza' shing sman gyi phywa= zhim mngar zas kyi phywa= bkrag can gos kyi= yid 'phrog rgyan gyi phywa= brjid can nor gyi phywa= mkhas pa'i mkhyen rtsal phywa= grub pa'i nus mthu'i phywa g.yang = 'phags pa'i spangs rtogs phywa= dam pa'i chos kyi phywa= bshad sgrub bstan pa'i phywa= 'chi med tshe yi phywa= bsod nams dbang thang =

snyan cing grags pa'i phywa= dpal dang 'byor pa'i phywa= nad med bde ba'i phywa= rgas med lang tsho'i phywa= ci bsam 'grub pa'i phywa= phywa khug g.yang skyobs dngos grub stsol: bkra shis bde legs rgyas par mdzod: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā: shrī ba su dhā ri ṇī sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: shar nas dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon nor bu bzang : btsun mo dpal ldan zla ba'i 'od: sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig gus pas bsgrubs lags na: byams pa'i zhal bzang sogs nas : bkra shis bde legs rgyas par mdzod: oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya tsan+d+ra kan+t+yai swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: lho nas dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon gang ba bzang : btsun mo dpal ldan nor sbyin ma: sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig gus pas sogs 'gre/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha drā ya dat+tā ye swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: nub nas dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon nor sbyin dang : btsun mo dpal ldan rab sbyin ma: sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig gus pa sogs= oṃ dha na dā+-i ya sudat+tā yai swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐/ byang nas dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon rnam thos sras: btsun mo dpal ldan 'phags ma dang : sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig sogs= oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya ārmā ye swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: shar lho'i dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon rol pa'i phreng : btsun mo dpal ldan rab bzang ma: sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig sogs/ oṃ ki li mā li ni su bha drā ye swā hā:

sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: lho nub dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon kuṇ+ḍa li: btsun mo dpal ldan rab sbas ma: sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig sogs= oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li su gup+tā ye swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: nub byang dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon sgo yi dbang : btsun mo dpal ldan mdzes ma dang : sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig sogs= oṃ mu khan+d+rā+e ya de bya swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: byang shar dngos grub stsol ba'i lha: gnod sbyin sde dpon g.yo ba'i dbang : btsun mo dpal ldan dbyangs can ma: sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: rtse gcig sogs= oṃ tsa ran+d+rā+e ya swa ra swat+yai swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi nas: sgrub la bar chad zlog pa dang : dngos grub stsol bar zhal bzhes pa'i: mthu chen rgyal po chen po bzhi: rang rang rigs kyi dpung bcas rnams: rtse gcig sogs= oṃ dhṛṣ+ta rāṣ+tā ya bai ru dha kā ya bi rū pak+ṣā ya bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: gzhan yang steng 'og bar mtshams nas: dngos grub rin chen char 'bebs pa'i: nor lha gter bdag rab 'byams tshogs: rtse gcig sogs= tad+ya thā: oṃ hi li ma ṇi bha dra: hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra: ki li ma ṇi bha dra: ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra: ku ru ma ṇi bha dra: ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra: tu ru ma ṇi bha dra: tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra: su ru ma ṇi bha dra: su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra: tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra: tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra: oṃ e h+ye hiḥ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: sarba ar+tha me sā dha ni: tad+ya thā: su dha ni: su ra s+yaḥ

su ma ti: su pu khiḥ hi li mi li swā hā: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus rat+na puṣ+tiṃ pa shaṃ ku ru ho: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal dang bcud bsdus pa'i g.yang rdzas gnod sbyin nor bdag chen po'i phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rnam rol lag tu gtad pas 'byor pa drug gi legs tshogs dpag bsam shing chen ltar rgyas shing ri dbang lhun po ltar brtan par gyur pa mos shig /g.yang rdzas rnams lag tu gtad la/ hā: 'khor 'das phywa g.yang 'dus pa'i bcud: phrin las rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas: tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags dang : stobs rtsal legs tshogs rgyas par shog: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā: karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: mtha' rten bkra shis tshe'i dngos grub sbyin pa'i slad du/ tshe'i 'brang rgyas 'di nyid mgon po dzam+bha la 'chi med tshe'i dbang phyug dngos su gsal ba spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pas/ sku gsung thugs las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus thams cad gang*/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang rdo rje lta bu'i srog thob par sgoms shig /tshe 'brang spyi bor bzhag la/ bh+rūm̐: 'khor 'das tshe la dbang bsgyur ba: mgon po 'chi med dzam+bha las: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: zhes bskur/ slar yang sngags de brjod la tshe ril dang tshe chang yang sbyin/ de ltar dpal ldan mgon po dzam+bha la'i dbang bskur thun mong ma yin pa thob pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngo bor gyur pa la bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin po che rnam pa bdun mdun du bstar/ shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs bcad brjod cing me tog gi char phabs pas mnga' gsol bar mos shig /byas la rdzas rtags rgyal srid rnams spyi 'gro'i tshigs bcad re re tsam brjod cing gtad/

shis brjod rgyas par bya/ de ltar na de dag rnams kyis yak+ṣa dzam+bha la'i snod rung byin brlab dbang bskur gyi rim pa legs par grub pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad dam tshig ma nyams pa tshul bzhin bsrung dgos pas de'i don rtsa ba'i gzhung las gsal rgyas su bstan pa 'di la snyan gtod par zhu/ de ltar dbang bskur thob pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas: dngos grub srog 'dzin dam tshig ni: snying dang mig las gces par bzung : nor lha mchod pa la brten nas: 'byor pa'i khyad par ci byung yang : cung zad tsam yang ma zhen par: rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang : phud kyis dkon mchog rten gsum bzhengs: mar me la sogs mchod rgyun 'dzugs: phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun bsnyen bkur zhing : pha ma nad pa dka' thub can: rgan rabs rnams la tshims par gtad: bar pa rang dang nye 'khor gyis: phung khams lha tshogs mchod pa'i blos: bza' btung gos rgyan 'byor pa bya: lhag ma dbul zhing phongs pa la: khong mi 'khrugs shing snying brtse bas: gtan pa med pa'i sbyin par spel: srog bslu bya zhing zam pa 'dzug: 'gras dang 'khrugs pa nor gyis bzlum: yul phyogs dge ba'i las rnams bya: de ni phyi yi dam tshig go: nor lha bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang : khyad par chu sbyin ma chag gtang : tshes brgyad sogs la lhag par mchod: shin tu gsang bas nyams su blang : gzhan la bka' rgya dam par spel: dpe dang lag len lhag par bsdam: rang gzhan dbul phongs ci byung yang : nor lha mchod pa ma gtogs par: log 'tsho sgrub pa'i bya ba spang : mdor na gnod sbyin nor lha dang : yi dam dbyer med snying ltar bcang : dam tshig gcig gis 'brel ba yi: mched lcam rnams la lhag par yang : byams dang bsnyen bkur ci nus bya: de ni nang gi dam tshig go: khyad par gdams pa zab mo 'di: gang las nod pa'i bla ma de: mi bskyod rdo rje sems dpa' dang : gsang bdag nor lha dbyer med par:

mos gus gdung shugs rgyun mi bcad: 'byor pa gang byung phud dang ni: bu dang bu mo nor gyi dbyig: na bza' bcud ldan zhal zas sogs: gces dang yid 'thad rtag tu dbul: gzung zur tsam yang gcag mi bya: 'dzum zhing gus pas gsong por gsol: thugs bzung mnyes pa'i bya ba bsgrub: rang sems lha dang bla ma dang : 'byor pa'i yo byad la sogs pa: 'khor gsum bden 'dzin bral ba'i ngang : don gyi dgongs pa'i srog gzung bya: de rnams gsang ba'i dam tshig go: de ltar dam tshig rab bsrung na: gnod sbyin nor lha ma bsgrub 'grub: tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor 'phel: mtho ris thar pa'i mchog thob 'gyur: ces gsungs pa'i tshig don rnams thugs la nges pa'i sgo nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig de dag ci nus su bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo byas la slob ma gyes/ slob dpon gyis gtang rag mchod bstod/ nongs bshags bzod gsol/ mdun bskyed bdag bskyed kyi gshegs bsdu/ dge bsngo shis brjod kyi bar las byang gi dkyus ltar byas pas grub bo/ /bdag nyid skye kun 'byor pa'i gter dang 'phrad/ gzhan phan snod bcud phywa g.yang byin spel bas/ /bstan 'gror dge mtshan dpal brgyas 'tsho byed pa/ /chu dbang snying rje can dang mtshungs par shog /ces pa'ang zab gsang khyad par 'phags pa 'di'i thog ma'i smin grol bdud rtsi'i snod rung du gyur pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwar gzhan phan gyi btsas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ /slar phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas nag 'gros su bgyis pa'o// //
